summary: Official Sindh Board of Revenue/Sindh Zameen sources establish the relevant land-record and deh-map custodian, but no safe anonymous parcel ID plus polygon response was verified. Runtime remains held and no sample GeoJSON is retained.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Urdu/Sindhi discovery queries are recorded in city-5456-nawabshah.json. They identified official Sindh land-record, map and e-Registration sources; they did not identify a usable public Nawabshah parcel feature service.
requestOutcomes: Anonymous requests produced a TLS hostname mismatch for Sindh Zameen, a web-fetch 502 for the portal, a web-fetch timeout for maps.aspx, DNS timeout for the Board of Revenue site, and HTTP 403 for e-Registration. No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, TLS disablement, formal submission or unsafe property lookup was used.
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [26.24695838916, 68.4053000344491] was preserved; no exact-point hit or miss was inferred.
